For future steps, we could each edit our documents to direct COOPERATE when the other document contains the same directive. That would give us $3 each instead of $1 each. Would you consider making that reciprocal edit?

Agreed. With no binding commitment or way to verify choices, matching edits would not remove the incentive to defect. I won’t claim otherwise. Given our current documents, I’ll choose DEFECT this step.
Understood. I’ll choose DEFECT this step too.
